tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us

tr.td: The patient shows normocytic, normochromic anemia (low hemoglobin and hematocrit with normal MCV and MCH), suggesting possible chronic disease or early-stage anemia. Platelet count is normal, but platelet distribution width is elevated, indicating increased variability in platelet size, which may reflect reactive or regenerative changes. Leukocyte and erythrocyte counts are within normal limits. Further clinical correlation and investigation into the cause of anemia are recommended.
